name: KeePassXC password manager
description: Official KeePassXC local password manager for supported Windows, macOS and Linux desktop systems.
license_note: KeePassXC is free and open source. Keep database backups encrypted and protect the database key separately.
notes: Use the official release for your OS and architecture.
Verify release signatures or checksums when the project publishes them.
Never upload an unencrypted password database to a public repository.
